response.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) as overall_average
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
),
status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    brokrepstat,
    AVG(modelconf) as avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
qualifying_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.brokrepstat,
    sa.avg_modelconf,
    oa.overall_average
  FROM status_avgs sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE sa.avg_modelconf > oa.overall_average
),
mean_of_qualifying AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as mean_qualifying
  FROM qualifying_statuses
)
SELECT 
  qs.brokrepstat as status,
  qs.avg_modelconf,
  qs.avg_modelconf - qs.overall_average as above_average,
  qs.avg_modelconf / mq.mean_qualifying as ratio
FROM qualifying_statuses qs
CROSS JOIN mean_of_qualifying mq
ORDER BY qs.brokrepstat;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average reference is the mean of all modelconf values across compliancecase (excluding NULLs), and statuses qualify when their individual average exceeds this overall average using strict inequality (>).
'Return nothing if a reference value is missing' means if overall_average is NULL (no non-NULL modelconf values exist), the query returns zero rows.
